pages.text: Returns the octal text of an integer.$(br2)Negative numbers use two's complement.
$(li)$(1)value$() INTEGER: the number$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the octal text

$(li)$(1)text$() STRING: the text$(li)$(1)pattern$() STRING: the regular expression$(li)$(1)replacement$() STRING: what replaces a match$(li)$(1)flags$() STRING: like sed, e.g. g or 2g (optional, default empty)$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the text with the replacements
in every line, and $(1)p$() to PRINT the result if something was replaced. Unknown flags, groups the pattern doesn't have and invalid patterns raise INVALID_ARGUMENT.
$(1)CALL c0de/strings/REGEX_REPLACE$(br)  PARAMETER text "2026-11-15" ;$(br)  PARAMETER pattern "([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)" ;$(br)  PARAMETER replacement "\3.\2.\1" ;$(br)  RESULT result german$()
